description: Fetch AI visibility (GEO) status for a tracked keyword the caller owns: the training-memory named rate (how often models answering from memory name the site) with per-model detail, the retrieval-grounded citation checks, and the visibility ranking against competitors. has_data:false with a reason means nothing is measured yet: the zeros are not a result. With has_data:true the training-memory rate can still be null when only live-search engines answered; read ground_truth then. Free: spends no credits.

tracked_keyword_id.description: ID of the tracked keyword to fetch GEO citation status for.

name: get_geo_citation_status
title: Get AI visibility (GEO) status
